name: gemini_api_key_provisioning
summary: Generate a free Gemini API key via the Google AI Studio cloud dashboard.
steps: Navigate browser to aistudio.google.com.
Sign in with Google credentials.
Click Create API key on the dashboard.
Assign a descriptive name (e.g., Jarvis version 4.0).
Copy generated API key and save to a local text file.
jarvis_use: Obtain cloud API credentials to power LLM conversational responses.

name: github_code_download
summary: Download the Mark-LIV personal assistant source code archive from GitHub.
steps: Visit github.com/FatihMakes/Mark-LIV.
Click the Code button dropdown.
Select Download ZIP to fetch the project archive.
jarvis_use: Acquire open-source repository files for inspection and adaptation.

name: source_archive_extraction
summary: Extract downloaded zip archives to a local destination directory.
steps: Locate downloaded Mark-LIV-main.zip file in File Explorer.
Right-click the zip file and choose Extract All.
Select target local folder and confirm extraction.
jarvis_use: Unpack application files prior to dependency setup and execution.

name: python_path_installation
summary: Install Python 3.11+ ensuring python.exe is explicitly added to PATH.
steps: Download Python installer (>3.11) from python.org.
Run installer wizard on host system.
Check Add python.exe to PATH checkbox before proceeding.
Click Install Now and complete setup.
jarvis_use: Ensure global terminal availability for Python scripts across system.

name: path_missing_troubleshooting
summary: Resolve unrecognized terminal commands by repairing Python PATH configuration.
steps: If terminal fails to execute py commands, re-launch Python installer.
Select Modify/Repair or re-install package.
Ensure Add python.exe to PATH checkbox is enabled.
Restart terminal to refresh environment paths.
jarvis_use: Fix executable path resolution issues during terminal setup.

name: vscode_workspace_initialization
summary: Load project folder in VS Code and open an integrated terminal session.
steps: Open Visual Studio Code.
Navigate to File -> Open Folder.
Select extracted Mark-LIV repository folder.
Open integrated terminal via Terminal -> New Terminal.
jarvis_use: Establish developer workspace environment for running agent scripts.

name: automated_dependency_setup_script
summary: Execute setup.py script to automatically fetch and install required Python packages.
steps: Open terminal in project root folder.
Run command 'py setup.py'.
Wait for pip installation processes to complete.
Confirm success message in terminal window.
jarvis_use: Automate single-command installation of python package dependencies.

name: gui_first_run_onboarding_modal
summary: Configure API credentials and host target OS via interactive startup wizard.
steps: Execute command 'py main.py' in terminal.
Paste saved Gemini API key into the designated input field.
Select target OS (Windows, macOS, or Linux) radio option.
Click Initialize Systems to boot assistant runtime.
jarvis_use: Provide interactive setup GUI for initial API key entry and platform selection.

name: software_rendered_3d_wireframe_avatar
summary: Render a software-based 3D facial wireframe mesh visualizer on dark HUD canvas.
steps: Load 3D head geometry mesh into software visualizer component.
Render glowing cyan HUD elements and eyes.
Animate head rotation and state indicators (LISTENING, SPEAKING, IDLE) dynamically.
jarvis_use: Provide visual HUD avatar feedback without requiring GPU engine dependencies.

name: formant_driven_lip_sync
summary: Animate avatar mouth shapes at 50Hz using real-time audio formant extraction.
steps: Capture generated TTS audio stream during voice synthesis.
Extract formant frequencies from speech audio buffer.
Map formant parameters to 50 distinct mouth viseme shapes per second.
Deform 3D wireframe mesh around mouth region synchronously.
jarvis_use: Synchronize visual avatar mouth movements with speech audio output.

name: spoken_hardware_telemetry_reporting
summary: Monitor CPU, RAM, thermals, and uptime to provide spoken hardware telemetry updates.
steps: Poll native OS performance counters for CPU utilization, RAM usage, thermals, and uptime.
Display metric bars on desktop HUD display.
Synthesize spoken status report summarizing hardware health metrics.
jarvis_use: Deliver voice diagnostic updates on host computer status and thermals.

name: recallable_contextual_memory
summary: Persist user dialogue context, reminders, and preferences locally for subsequent retrieval.
steps: Extract key entities, dates, and reminders from conversation input.
Save structured context into local database or JSON store.
Query local context database upon user prompt to retrieve past facts or schedules.
jarvis_use: Maintain persistent cross-session memory for deadlines and user preferences.

name: voice_intent_system_automation
summary: Parse vocal commands to execute local application launches and OS scripting tasks.
steps: Parse user vocal phrase (e.g., 'initiate workspace') into target intent.
Trigger matching executable script inside plugins/ directory.
Launch target program (e.g. VS Code) and list directory contents via shell command.
jarvis_use: Control local Mac application workspaces using direct natural language voice triggers.

name: assistant_autostart_boot_toggle
summary: Configure assistant script to automatically launch when host operating system boots.
steps: Open assistant GUI settings menu.
Locate Auto start toggle switch.
Enable switch to register background launch daemon or registry startup task.
jarvis_use: Ensure agent auto-launches upon macOS boot using LaunchAgent plist.
